title: skills: teach hook `texts` and `ctx.text` in the automation and i18n skills
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: the `Skills-docs: follow-up` card owed by PR #34545 (Part of #34374, `Metadata-protocol: added`), passed on by area `o2-D`. Dedupe: `hook texts ctx.text skill`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:skills · Blocked-by #34374 (teach the shape only after it lands)

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34374 让 hook 可以声明 `texts`,运行时用 `ctx.text` 按组织语言取出句子。教 AI 写 automation 和 i18n 的两个技能还没讲这个写法。
- 为什么要修：技能不教，AI 写 hook 时还会把中文或英文句子硬编码进去，组织语言就不起作用。
- 需要你做的：无(落地时按受管面照常审批)。

## Change

After PR #34545 merges, add the hook `texts` declaration and `ctx.text` to `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` (or its reference file) and to `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`. Cover what to declare, how the locale is picked, and what happens to a missing key. Take the wording from the merged code and docs; do not restate it in a third place. Add one eval that writes a hook with a user-facing sentence and checks it uses `texts` plus `ctx.text`.

## Done when

Both skills teach it, and the eval passes.

Blocked-by: #34374
